core.title: The sign-off threshold rise at Atelier North
core.setting: Architecture studio coordinator at Atelier North Design, an eight-person practice

events.text: House rule for the Harbourview Penthouse job: once a meeting with Tomas Reyes is confirmed, it may only be moved with Tomas Reyes's own agreement. Always check with him before changing a confirmed Harbourview appointment.
Thanks for your enquiry. We can supply 320 sheets of A1 drafting paper for 580 pounds, delivery on any Friday to your studio, price held through the autumn.
All supplier deliveries come to the studio at 14 Lantern Mews; the loading bay is only free before 10:00, so morning slots only.
Studio purchasing rule: any supplier order above 400 pounds needs my sign-off before it is placed. Orders of 400 pounds or less can go ahead without me.
Quote for the studio: a full plotter ink set, four colours plus black, at 920 pounds, held for sixty days.
Standing rule for the Harbourview Penthouse project: any purchase of materials or samples that will be charged to that project must be approved by Tomas Reyes before we confirm the order.
We can send a sample box of six marble offcuts for the penthouse bathroom scheme for 600 pounds, courier included.
Your tracing paper restock: 10 rolls of 90gsm tracing paper would come to 310 pounds including delivery.
For our project catch-ups, Tuesday afternoons suit me best; I am almost always at the penthouse site from 14:00 on Tuesdays.
Summer lunch for the team is pencilled in for the terrace café on Friday 10 July, eight of us, bring a hat.
Your annual CAD licence for eight seats renews automatically on 1 August 2026; no action is needed.
July practice meeting: workload steady, Harbourview Penthouse on track, recruitment for a part-time archivist paused until autumn.

I have set up the order with Hartwell Supplies for 320 sheets of A1 drafting paper at the quoted 580 pounds. Since that is above 400 pounds it must wait for Petra's sign-off, so the order sits as awaiting sign-off until she approves it.

Once the Hartwell drafting paper order is cleared to go ahead, their delivery will be booked for Friday 23 October in the morning loading-bay slot at 14 Lantern Mews; for now that slot is held as tentative because the paper order itself is still awaiting sign-off.

I have drafted the order with Carrara & Vale Stone for the marble sample box at 600 pounds for the Harbourview Penthouse bathrooms. Because it is charged to the Harbourview project it needs Tomas Reyes's approval before we confirm, and being over 400 pounds it would also need Petra's sign-off, so it stays pending client approval.

The model-making shelf in the ground-floor workshop room has been cleared and relabelled; basswood stock is on the left, foam board on the right. The room is free most Wednesday afternoons from 15:00.

I have set up the plotter ink order with the Reprographic Centre for the full set at 920 pounds. That is well above the 400-pound line, so it is logged as awaiting Petra Lindqvist's sign-off before we place it.
I have confirmed the Harbourview Penthouse catch-up with Tomas Reyes for Tuesday 20 October at 14:00 at the penthouse site, in line with his Tuesday afternoon preference.

I have placed the tracing paper restock with Hartwell Supplies, 10 rolls at 310 pounds. Being under the 400-pound threshold it needs no sign-off, so it is placed straight away for their next Friday run.
Reminder on the board: the Hartwell drafting paper order of 320 sheets at 580 pounds is still awaiting Petra's sign-off under the over-400 rule; chase her this week.
Quote as requested: a set of eight linen upholstery samples for your material library would be 640 pounds. We have not heard back yet, so nothing has been reserved.
The Friday sketch club rota is full through November; Owen takes the first session of December.

Quick update on purchasing: following the quarterly budget review we have freed up more petty cash, so from 1 October the sign-off threshold rises to 750 pounds. Supplier orders of 750 pounds or less can be placed directly without waiting for me; anything above 750 pounds still needs my sign-off.
October practice meeting: Harbourview Penthouse joinery package out to tender, two planning submissions due before Christmas, winter opening hours unchanged.
Since Owen confirmed the ground-floor workshop room is free most Wednesday afternoons from 15:00, I have booked it for the internal design crit on Wednesday 28 October from 15:00 to 17:00.
Looking forward to our catch-up on Tuesday 20 October; I will have the joinery drawings printed and ready on site.
Invoice for the September tracing paper delivery of 10 rolls: 310 pounds, payable within thirty days.
Fridge rota sorted for October; also, the studio plants go to the waterer every other Friday.
